title: Round 39 - blurry pictures redrawn (all batches)
intro: 180 blurry or faint mark-scheme pictures from all maths batches are now drawn again (tables, shapes on grids, dot patterns, pie charts, Venns, graphs). 10 to check, 5 calibration items (I think they match - do you agree?) and 1 decision. Each note says what to look at.
subject: Physics

reasons: Mark scheme 14(d): the cumulative frequency curve drawn through the points of the table (crosses + smooth curve) on the question's axes. OK?
Mark scheme 8(a): the bearings sketch redrawn: North lines, 060 and 150 degree arcs, 300 m and 220 m, the return to A dashed as printed. OK?
Calibration: 11(a) and 11(b): the two graphical-method screenshots of 11(b) each redrawn from its own pair of graphs. Does it match?

Mark scheme 3(b), 3(c)(i), 3(c)(ii): the hand-drawn grid pictures are redrawn - the added square in black or grey, the three answers one under the other with OR, the dashed lines of symmetry. Right squares and lines?
Calibration: 9(b)(i): the question gives no formula, so the curve was fitted to the printed sketch (same zeros and minimum), then moved 2 left. Good enough?
Mark scheme 4(b)(ii): the hand-drawn pie chart redrawn with the right angles (60, 105, 120, 75 degrees). The original wrote 2 for 29 - we print 29. OK?
Mark scheme 4: the parallelogram on its grid redrawn with the box around it and the areas 3, 2, 6, 6, 2, 3. Numbers in the right places?
Mark scheme 3(b): the blurry table is now a real table - bold numbers are the answers, grey numbers were given in the question. Same numbers as the original?
Calibration: 7(d)(i) and 7(d)(ii): the arch f(x) fitted to the printed sketch, then moved up 2 / left 3. Good enough?
Mark scheme 7(a)(i): the hand-written Venn with three circles redrawn. Each number in the same region as the original?
Mark scheme 4: the mapping diagram redrawn (two ovals, arrows, the given numbers in brackets as printed). OK?
Mark scheme 2(a), 2(b), 2(c): triangles and hexagons redrawn on the dotty paper in grey (the original is coloured). Is grey fine?
DECISION: 10(a) is a hand sketch of the student's own triangle (root(r^2 - w^2) along the top, r on the slant). Kept as printed - redraw it as a right-angled triangle with those labels, or keep?
Calibration: 9(c)(i) Partial Marks: the two small graphs one above the other redrawn from the model D = (V^2 + V root(V^2 + 80))/20. Does it match?
Calibration: 14(b)(i): the handwritten tree redrawn with fractions and words (A / NA written in full as apple / not an apple, as in the question). OK?
